summary: TODO-004 satisfies the approved acceptance criteria. The implementation enforces SUN-only participant tagging, removes static/manual/UID-only checkpoint acceptance, adds admin SUN registration and baseline refresh flows, preserves the invite QR, and provides required static plus browser validation evidence.
warnings: Physical Android Web NFC scanning and real NTAG 424 DNA taps were not exercised in this environment; this limitation is documented in the implementation and TODO validation notes.
evidence: Read mandatory reviewer rules from `.ai/reviewer/REVIEWER.md` and required artifacts for TASK-20260927-001/TODO-004.

Inspected the primary implementation files: `src/app/api/tag/route.ts`, `src/app/t/[token]/page.tsx`, `participant-landing.tsx`, `admin-sun-panel.tsx`, `src/app/race/page.tsx`, admin tag routes, `src/lib/nfc.ts`, `src/lib/db.ts`, `src/lib/sun-keys.ts`, `src/lib/types.ts`, and `supabase/migrations/20260927150000_sun_register.sql`.
Verified `/api/tag` accepts only valid `{e,c}` SUN parameters and calls `verifySun` before `store.recordSunTag`; token and UID-only bodies return errors.
Verified admin-only SUN routes require `isAdmin()`, return 401 without admin auth, and registration/inspect operations re-verify SUN parameters server-side.
Verified `register_tag_sun` locks the tag row, prevents same-session UID conflicts, requires confirmation for replacing a different UID, and refuses baseline decreases for the same UID.
Verified `/race` no longer has manual tag-code submission and Web NFC submission routes through `parseSunUrl` to SUN payloads only.
Verified admin NFC UI removes tag QR, static NFC write, token copy, and UID binding controls while preserving the invite QR panel.
Static validation evidence exists at `runtime/static/TODO-004/summary.txt`: `VALIDATE_STATUS=PASSED`, `LINT_BASELINE=MATCH`, `TSC_EXIT=0`; `lint-delta.txt` says `no new lint findings`.

Browser validation evidence exists at `runtime/web/TODO-004/report.md` with `BROWSER_STATUS=PASSED`, URL, exercised steps, no coordinate interactions, and screenshots. Spot-checked screenshots for admin NFC registration, admin `/t` mode, pending participant submission, and static token rejection.
API and SUN test evidence passed: `api-check-004.local.out.txt` reports `RESULT failures=0`; `test-sun.out.txt` reports 11/11 passing tests.

TODO-003 affected surfaces: SUN verification, replay rejection, baseline rejection, concurrent identical payload handling, and concurrent fresh URL behavior were covered by API evidence.
TODO-001 affected race behavior: team credit, out-of-order rejection, finish/ranking, and database cleanup were covered by API/browser evidence.
